column4: Visit note | 2026-03-14 03:00 PM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Habiba Patwary, 59, female. Mrs. Patwary returns for a follow-up review, reporting that she has been intolerant of heat and losing weight despite eating quite well lately. She is a shopkeeper and first noticed something was amiss when her clothes became loose during a stay in Jashore. She denies tremors, palpitations at rest, or vision changes. On examination: pulse 111 bpm, BP 134/71 mmHg, weight 54 kg. She appears alert with brisk reflexes and no eye signs. Assessment: Hyperthyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued for her ongoing management. She was advised to avoid excess tea and coffee and to rest when her heart races. Follow-up in 4 weeks with thyroid function tests.
